## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (57%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability check failed; the 90% set holds all four classes [F1][F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 57%, Normal 17%, Benign 16%, Invasive 10% | Not decisive |
| Conformal set | All four classes | No separation |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.003 / 88th percentile | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Gland/tubule formation** (regions 2, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; failed spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect classifier. Mitoses unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Input is flagged (reliability 0.003), so all probabilities, including 57% InSitu, may be off.
- Regions 1, 5, 9 score high for invasive, yet whole-image invasive probability is only 10%.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 5, 9**: look for invasive tumor; highest invasive contribution and per-region risk.
2. **3, 7, 11**: confirm benign stroma or fat, the validated feature pointing away from invasive.
3. **4**: look for intraductal atypical cells; the concept is Weak (12/20) and this is its only region.
